speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe when the gait and limb ataxia started and whether it has been getting progressively worse? Also, do you have any history of neurological disorders, alcohol use, or recent infections?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the right-sided predominance of your symptoms, I need to assess for other focal neurological signs. Do you experience any numbness, weakness, or vision changes, and do you have a history of cardiovascular risk factors like hypertension or diabetes?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any recent episodes of fever, severe headache, or cognitive changes while on natalizumab? REQUEST TEST: Brain MRI with contrast
